inputs.text: Original cozy fantasy adventure game props, warm hand-painted storybook illustration, the same consistent slightly overhead three-quarter camera for every object, amber upper-left light, cool deep teal shadows, copper metal, carved old wood, muted mossy slate stone. Simple bold silhouettes readable at 32 pixels, three broad value groups, sparse small details. No photorealism, no characters, no text, no letters, no symbols resembling writing. A PROFESSIONAL SPRITE SHEET with exactly THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS, SIX equal square cells. One complete isolated game prop centered in each cell, generous empty margins, no overlap. First row from left to right: (1) a square wooden seed CRATE with crossed timber braces and copper corners, closed flat lid, unmistakably a pushable box; (2) a mechanical SWITCH with a long copper lever tilted left, set into a squat mossy stone pedestal, large handle visible; (3) a very flat circular PRESSURE PLATE lying on the floor, dark central wooden disk inset into a thick copper ring, no pedestal, no vertical parts. Second row from left to right: (4) an archery TARGET made of a large upright circular copper ring with a dark turquoise center and bright cream bullseye, held by two short stone feet; (5) a small tall freestanding LAMP with a cream glass globe held within curved copper leaf ribs on a narrow dark teal stem and round stone foot, no lever and no target ring; (6) a stationary magical TURRET, a squat mossy stone owl automaton on a broad circular base, two amber eye lenses and a short round copper emitter projecting forwards from its chest, no wheels, no legs. Entire canvas a plain uniform saturated MAGENTA backdrop. No surrounding landscape, no ground square, no scenery, no base tile, no border, no visible grid, no drop shadow outside objects. Six separate usable assets, all fully inside their cells.
